summary_en: 5,000,000 shares (3.88% of 128,898,301 shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥5,000M ceiling, open-market purchases Aug 7, 2026–Feb 26, 2027, all acquired shares to be cancelled Mar 12, 2027. Rationale: shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: TOKAI Holdings Corporation announced on August 6, 2026 that its board has approved the acquisition and cancellation of up to 5,000,000 treasury shares. The buyback will be executed via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from August 7, 2026 through February 26, 2027, with a total budget ceiling of ¥5,000 million. This represents 3.88% of the 128,898,301 shares outstanding (excluding treasury). All shares acquired under this authorization will be cancelled on March 12, 2027. The company stated that the acquisition and cancellation are intended to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency as part of its medium-term management plan (announced May 2026), which prioritizes business profit expansion and stronger capital returns while maximizing enterprise value. The disclosure notes that this buyback programme is unrelated to a separate announcement on the same date regarding additional equity contributions to a share-grant trust (BBT).
